CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS annotation_comparison_sessions (
  id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
  name VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
  description TEXT,
  productModelId INT,
  serialNumber VARCHAR(100),
  machineId INT,
  inspectionIds JSON NOT NULL,
  comparisonResult JSON,
  detectedPatterns JSON,
  status ENUM('PENDING', 'PROCESSING', 'COMPLETED', 'FAILED') DEFAULT 'PENDING' NOT NULL,
  errorMessage TEXT,
  createdBy INT NOT NULL,
  createdByName VARCHAR(255),
  createdAt TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL,
  updatedAt TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL,
  INDEX idx_comparison_product (productModelId),
  INDEX idx_comparison_serial (serialNumber),
  INDEX idx_comparison_machine (machineId),
  INDEX idx_comparison_status (status),
  INDEX idx_comparison_created (createdAt)
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS defect_heatmap_data (
  id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
  factoryId INT,
  workshopId INT,
  lineId INT,
  stationId INT,
  machineId INT,
  productModelId INT,
  periodType ENUM('HOURLY', 'DAILY', 'WEEKLY', 'MONTHLY') NOT NULL,
  periodStart TIMESTAMP NOT NULL,
  periodEnd TIMESTAMP NOT NULL,
  gridWidth INT NOT NULL,
  gridHeight INT NOT NULL,
  heatmapGrid JSON NOT NULL,
  totalDefects INT DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  maxDefectsInCell INT DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  hotspots JSON,
  topLocations JSON,
  generatedAt TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL,
  processingTimeMs INT,
  INDEX idx_heatmap_factory (factoryId),
  INDEX idx_heatmap_machine (machineId),
  INDEX idx_heatmap_product (productModelId),
  INDEX idx_heatmap_period (periodType),
  INDEX idx_heatmap_generated (generatedAt)
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS ai_suggestions (
  id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
  inspectionId INT NOT NULL,
  measurementResultId INT,
  suggestionType ENUM('DEFECT_CLASSIFICATION', 'ROOT_CAUSE', 'CORRECTIVE_ACTION', 'QUALITY_PREDICTION', 'PROCESS_OPTIMIZATION') NOT NULL,
  suggestion TEXT NOT NULL,
  confidence DECIMAL(5,4) NOT NULL,
  reasoning TEXT,
  alternatives JSON,
  modelVersion VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL,
  modelName VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL,
  status ENUM('PENDING', 'ACCEPTED', 'REJECTED', 'REVIEWED') DEFAULT 'PENDING' NOT NULL,
  createdAt TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL,
  INDEX idx_ai_suggestion_inspection (inspectionId),
  INDEX idx_ai_suggestion_type (suggestionType),
  INDEX idx_ai_suggestion_status (status),
  INDEX idx_ai_suggestion_model (modelName, modelVersion)
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS ai_feedback (
  id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
  suggestionId INT NOT NULL,
  feedbackType ENUM('CORRECT', 'INCORRECT', 'PARTIAL', 'UNSURE') NOT NULL,
  accuracy INT,
  correctedValue TEXT,
  correctionNotes TEXT,
  errorCategory ENUM('FALSE_POSITIVE', 'FALSE_NEGATIVE', 'MISCLASSIFICATION', 'WRONG_LOCATION', 'WRONG_SEVERITY', 'OTHER'),
  includedInTraining BOOLEAN DEFAULT FALSE NOT NULL,
  trainingBatchId VARCHAR(100),
  feedbackBy INT NOT NULL,
  feedbackByName VARCHAR(255),
  feedbackAt TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL,
  INDEX idx_ai_feedback_suggestion (suggestionId),
  INDEX idx_ai_feedback_type (feedbackType),
  INDEX idx_ai_feedback_training (includedInTraining),
  INDEX idx_ai_feedback_batch (trainingBatchId)
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS ai_model_metrics (
  id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
  modelName VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL,
  modelVersion VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL,
  periodStart TIMESTAMP NOT NULL,
  periodEnd TIMESTAMP NOT NULL,
  totalSuggestions INT DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  reviewedSuggestions INT DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  correctCount INT DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  incorrectCount INT DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  partialCount INT DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  accuracy DECIMAL(5,4),
  metricsByType JSON,
  errorBreakdown JSON,
  accuracyTrend ENUM('IMPROVING', 'DECLINING', 'STABLE') DEFAULT 'STABLE',
  generatedAt TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL,
  INDEX idx_ai_metrics_model (modelName, modelVersion),
  INDEX idx_ai_metrics_period (periodStart, periodEnd)
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS ai_training_batches (
  id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
  batchId VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  name VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
  description TEXT,
  feedbackCount INT DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  correctSamples INT DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  incorrectSamples INT DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  exportFormat ENUM('JSON', 'CSV', 'JSONL', 'PARQUET') DEFAULT 'JSONL' NOT NULL,
  exportUrl TEXT,
  status ENUM('PENDING', 'PROCESSING', 'COMPLETED', 'FAILED', 'UPLOADED') DEFAULT 'PENDING' NOT NULL,
  targetModelName VARCHAR(100),
  targetModelVersion VARCHAR(50),
  createdBy INT NOT NULL,
  createdByName VARCHAR(255),
  createdAt TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL,
  completedAt TIMESTAMP,
  INDEX idx_training_batch_id (batchId),
  INDEX idx_training_batch_status (status),
  INDEX idx_training_batch_created (createdAt)
);
